arStrings.szText: Critical Hits with {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} cause the spear to arc to the target and up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} other enemies. This damage is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1" * 100|x%|]{/c} of your Critical Strike Damage Bonus.
{c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} arcs to its target and nearby enemies.
